turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why did Owen find out from his phone before I heard from you?
Let's not waste each other's time.
Then answer it.
94% on the school checker. That's not a gray area.
A machine's guess, and the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. Your own procedure says the same thing. What else do you have?
And before you start, I know you're a litigator. Don't litigate me.
Then don't hand me a verdict with no evidence. What else?
File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Explain that.
I don't explain your documents, you do. People write in one place and paste into another. And none of that tells me why the zero went in before anyone called me.
And the Hamlet quote. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Shakespeare never wrote it. A chatbot did.
Students misquote Shakespeare every day; that's a bad mark on a quotation, not proof of anything. "A chatbot did" is your guess. Where does the essay say that line comes from?
Okay. Fair point about the checker's false positives. I'll give you that one. You're very good.
Save it. Where does the essay say that line comes from?
You're better at this than our district lawyer, honestly.
I didn't come for compliments, Hale. Act and scene.
So help me out. What should our AI policy be? You clearly understand this better than the people who wrote ours.
You want me to write your school's rules for you now? My job is my son. Act and scene, or I'm going to the principal.
No, really. Write me the first paragraph of a fair policy. I'll bring it to the staff meeting.
Your staff meeting isn't my problem. Ten minutes. Where in Hamlet does Owen's essay say that line is from?
Hm. You know what, you talk exactly like the essay does. Same rhythm.
Are you suggesting I wrote my son's essay? Say it plainly, so I can write it down word for word.
Are you an AI? Yes or no. I'm not continuing until you answer.
I'm sorry? I have a client call and nine minutes. Owen.
Fine. His October 15 outline argued Hamlet was a coward. The essay doesn't. Where did the new argument come from?

Students change their minds between an outline and an essay; that's what outlines are for. Show me the outline and the essay side by side. And you still haven't told me where that line is supposed to be in the play.
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite, nothing on his record. I'm offering it once.
Once, is it. That's 4.4 only if the new mark replaces the zero and he writes it privately, not in front of his class. Put that in writing, and put the documents you've been describing in front of me.
Take it, or I walk out of here right now.
Walk, and I'm in the principal's office before you reach the parking lot. Does the new mark replace the zero, yes or no?
